newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Prairies frost free despite record lows.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Prairies frost free despite record lows.

text.p: Canada's Prairie grainbelt was free of frost over the weekend as temperatures set record lows, Environment Canada said.

"As far as frost goes, the only report I had was up around Hodgson (Manitoba) which is really border line as far as the grainbelt goes, it was an unofficial report where he mentioned that the corn in his garden was damaged by frost," meteorologist Steve Smith said.
The normal low at this time of year is 13 Celsius (55 F).
Winnipeg set a low of 2.7 Celsius (36.86 F) Sunday morning, breaking the prior record of 2.8 Celsius set in 1908.
Gimli, Manitoba, set a record low of 3.8 Celsius (38.84 F) Sunday morning, breaking the prior record of 5.9 Celsius in 1984.
Cool temperatures were due to a high pressure system from the Arctic.
